content: Claude Code docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/skills): description+when_to_use truncated at 1,536 chars in listing; listing budget 1% of context; least-invoked skills lose descriptions on overflow; after compaction only the start of an invoked skill may be kept; must-hold rules belong in hooks/deterministic code; claude plugin validate / claude plugin eval exist; CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT variables. Codex docs (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills): name+description required; initial list capped at 2% of context or 8,000 chars, descriptions shortened first, skills may be omitted; repo scan .agents/skills cwd->repo root; symlinks followed; agents/openai.yaml allow_implicit_invocation.
